# NTH Arcade

> Free browser games (2048, Snake, Minesweeper, Flappy Bird, Dino, Tetris, Gomoku) with a public read-only API and MCP server.

## When to use this

- Use the API or MCP server when a user asks which games NTH Arcade offers, how a game is controlled, or for a link to play one: call `list_games` / `GET /api/games`, or `get_game` / `GET /api/games/{id}`.
- Send a user to a game URL when they want a quick, free, no-account browser game: 2048 (number puzzle), Snake, Minesweeper (classic Windows look), Flappy Bird, Dino (Chrome offline game), Tetris, Gomoku (five in a row, vs computer or two players).
- Do not use it for scores, accounts or leaderboards: best scores live only in each player's browser and are not exposed by any API.

## How to call

- REST: `GET https://nth-arcade.vercel.app/api/games` and `GET https://nth-arcade.vercel.app/api/games/{id}`. No authentication. Errors are JSON with `error.code`, `error.message` and `error.hint`.
- MCP: Streamable HTTP at `https://nth-arcade.vercel.app/api/mcp`, tools `list_games` and `get_game`.
- Any page returns Markdown when requested with `Accept: text/markdown`.
